---
layout: archive
title: "Publications"
permalink: /publications/
author_profile: true
---

<!-- Selected publication list auto-generated by [InsPy-HEP](https://github.com/mhostert/inspy-hep). -->
For a complete and up-to-date list of publications, see my [INSPIRE](https://inspirehep.net/authors/1621061?ui-citation-summary=true) page.

{% include base_path %}

<div class="pub-controls">
  <button id="pub-expand-btn" class="btn btn--small">Expand All</button>
</div>

{% assign sorted = site.publications | reverse %}

{% for year_num in (2017..2030) reversed %}
  {% assign year = year_num | append: '' %}
  {% assign has_pubs = false %}
  
  {% for post in sorted %}
    {% capture date_str %}{{post.date}}{% endcapture %}
    {% if date_str contains year %}
      {% assign has_pubs = true %}
      {% break %}
    {% endif %}
  {% endfor %}
  
  {% if has_pubs %}
  <div class="year-section">
    <h2 class="year-subheader">{{ year }}</h2>
    <ol>
      {% for post in sorted %}
        {% capture date_str %}{{post.date}}{% endcapture %}
        {% if date_str contains year %}
          {% include archive-pubs.html %}
        {% endif %}
      {% endfor %}
    </ol>
  </div>
  {% endif %}
{% endfor %}

<script>
(function () {
  var btn = document.getElementById('pub-expand-btn');
  var expanded = false;
  btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    expanded = !expanded;
    document.querySelectorAll('.pub-entry__details').forEach(function (el) {
      el.open = expanded;
    });
    btn.textContent = expanded ? 'Collapse All' : 'Expand All';
  });
})();
</script>
